title:
Epic to clear and setup the {@link ModelScenarioApplicationState} with the
{@link ReliabilityMl.Pipeline} `lookbackDuration` and the {@link ReliabilityAsset} that is
associated with the {@link ReliabilityMlModel} the scenario is based on.

**NOTE**: No payload is expected to be passed to this epic, as the "action" is simply to
          trigger the initialization of the application state.

Additionally, this epic clears all the components that are part of the Model Scenario Page.
name: InitializeModelScenarioApplicationStateEpic
